bio: This North German family-run establishment is pretty as a picture! After being welcomed into the attractive inn built in 1887 with a lively local greeting (moin), you can expect good, attentive service in a modern and thoroughly chic ambience. Chef Tjark-Peter Maaß cooks tasty dishes of a regional bent. For example, the fried North Sea plaice, fried potatoes, cucumber salad, Tönning shrimps is a tasty and fresh option – one of the classics. There are also some appealing and cosy guestrooms for an overnight stay....
